A '''tachytrope''' is a [[curve]] in which the law of the [[velocity]] is given.  It was first used by [[United States|American]] [[mathematician]] [[Benjamin Peirce]] in ''A System of Analytic Mechanics'', first published in 1855.{{Sfn|Peirce|1855|pp=364–370}}
